title: Network Engineer
description:
Job description We are looking for a skilled Network Engineer in New Delhi. The candidate will be responsible for network maintenance, troubleshooting, technical support, and ensuring smooth day-to-day network operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor and maintain network infrastructure and connectivity. Troubleshoot LAN/WAN and network-related issues. Handle network incidents, service requests, and technical escalations. Perform network configuration and basic troubleshooting of Cisco devices. Diagnose connectivity, routing, switching, and related network issues. Coordinate with internal teams and customers for timely issue resolution. Maintain proper documentation of network incidents and activities. Provide on-site technical support as required. Ensure network services are available and functioning efficiently. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Networking fundamentals. Hands-on knowledge of Cisco networking devices. Knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, Switching & Routing. Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Customer-facing / IT support experience will be an advantage. Good communication and coordination skills. Educational Qualification Option 1: 
 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Computer Science / IT with minimum 1 year of experience in Network Maintenance/Support along with CCNA certification. OR Option 2: 
 Diploma in Electronics / Computer Science / IT with minimum 2 years of experience in Network Maintenance/Support along with CCNA certification. Experience Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a Network Engineer or above. Candidates with experience in IT Infrastructure / Network Support / IT Services are preferred. Certification CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) Mandatory Preferred Profile Network Engineer / Network Support Engineer Experience in IT Services / Infrastructure Support Strong troubleshooting skills Immediate / short-notice joiners preferred

Key Skills: Routing,CCNA,Switching,Cisco Certified,Network Administration,Cisco Certified Network Professional,Network Engineering,NOC Operations
